general.level.description: Verbosity level: 0 (none) to 7 (debug); higher means more verbose logging

general.path.description: Absolute path to the directory where log files are stored

general.max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per log file before rotation (10 MB default)

general.max_files.description: Number of rotated log files to retain

general.rotate.description: Enable automatic log file rotation when size limit is reached

general.flush.description: Force immediate disk write for each log message (use with caution — may impact performance)

general.rate_limit.description: Maximum log entries per second; set to 0 to disable rate limiting

general.hostname.description: Override auto-detected hostname in log messages (empty = use system hostname)

ipc.socket_path.description: Absolute path to the directory for IPC Unix sockets

ipc.shm_enabled.description: Enable shared memory transport for efficient inter-process communication

ipc.shm_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the shared memory segment (2 MB default)

storage.enabled.description: Enable persistent storage of logs (e.g., to local filesystem)

storage.path.description: Absolute path to the directory for persistent storage

storage.compress.description: Compress stored log files (uses gzip compression)

storage.max_size.description: Maximum total size (in bytes) of stored logs; 0 = unlimited (100 MB default)

storage.min_free_space.description: Stop storing logs when free disk space falls below this value (50 MB default)

mgmt.enabled.description: Enable the HTTP management interface (not recommended for untrusted networks)

mgmt.port.description: TCP port for the HTTP management interface

mgmt.tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the management interface

mgmt.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format)

mgmt.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format)

filters.description: List of filters to control which messages are logged (by ECU, Application ID, and Context ID)

receivers.description: List of remote DLT receivers (daemons) to forward logs to

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote receiver

port.description: UDP/TCP port of the remote receiver (typically 31322)

type.description: Transport protocol to use (tcp or udp)
